items.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate election
items.title_zh: 民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉赢得阿拉斯加州参议院选举
items.summary: Peltola's defeat of incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan gives Democrats a solid majority of 56 seats in the Senate as of January.
items.summary_zh: 佩尔托拉击败了现任共和党参议员丹·沙利文，使民主党在1月份的参议院中获得了56个席位的绝对多数。

items.title: 7 Scene-Stealing Gifts for the 2026 Holiday Season
items.summary: The holidays are officially in full swing, and finding the perfect gift just got a lot easier. From the tech lover and the wellness enthusiast to the homebody and the friend who has everything, we rounded up the season’s standout gifts that feel thoughtful, a little bit luxe and…
items.summary_zh: 节日季已正式全面开启，寻找完美礼物的过程也变得更加轻松。从科技爱好者和健康养生达人，到宅家一族和应有尽有的朋友，我们为您搜罗了本季的精选礼物，既贴心又略显奢华，而且……

items.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition ahead of meeting with Trump, Xi
items.title_zh: 普京在与特朗普、习近平会晤前表示，欧盟正在失去工业，在竞争中落后
items.summary: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country.
items.summary_zh: 普京在讲话中强调，尽管受到美国的制裁，俄罗斯的经济仍具有韧性，并着重介绍了亚太经合组织成员国在该国的机遇。

items.title: China’s Xi calls for removing trade and investment barriers ahead of his meeting with Trump and Putin
items.title_zh: 习近平在与特朗普和普京会晤前呼吁消除贸易和投资壁垒
items.summary: Xi opened the APEC summit in Shenzhen by calling for lower trade and investment barriers, pledging broader access to China’s market and manufacturing sector.
items.summary_zh: 习近平在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会上致开幕词，呼吁降低贸易和投资壁垒，并承诺更广泛地开放中国市场和制造业。

items.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Sets First-Ever Live Finale for Season 35
items.title_zh: 《与星共舞》第35季将首次举办现场直播决赛
items.summary: For the first time in “Dancing With the Stars” history, the ballroom competition show will air its finale live. The three-hour finale will air on Nov. 24 from 8:00-11:00 p.m. ET, 7:00-10:00 p.m. CT, 6:00-9:00 p.m. MT and 5:00-8:00 p.m. PT on ABC and Disney+.
items.summary_zh: 在《与星共舞》的历史上，这档国标舞竞技节目将首次以直播形式播出决赛。长达三小时的决赛将于11月24日晚8:00-11:00（美国东部时间）、7:00-10:00（美国中部时间）、6:00-9:00（美国山区时间）和5:00-8:00（美国太平洋时间）在ABC和Disney+上播出。

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.title_zh: 英伟达的初创企业投资额飙升至650亿美元，但黄仁勋的退出使未来交易蒙上阴影
items.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
items.summary_zh: 在过去九个月里，英伟达的私募投资价值几乎翻了两番，这得益于黄仁勋积极的交易活动及其现有投资组合公司的估值不断攀升。

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.title_zh: 英伟达承诺，目前营收将继续飙升
items.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
items.summary_zh: 尽管在声名狼藉的创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋离职后，Nvidia 陷入了动荡，但该公司预计其创纪录的营收势头不会就此止步。

items.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
items.title_zh: 萨蒂亚·纳德拉表示，他现在已经“吃下AGI的药”了
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it.
items.summary_zh: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，他相信AGI，至少在谈到人工智能可能会对经济结构带来惊人变化，以及政治可能会因此而发生变化时，他相信AGI。

items.title: Our favorite bath towel is already on sale for Black Friday
items.title_zh: 我们最喜爱的浴巾已在黑色星期五促销
items.summary: The best bath towel we have reviewed this past year, by Parachute, is 20% off from now through Cyber Monday. So is our favorite filtered showerhead Welcome to Worth it , where Filter editors spotlight one genuinely good discount on something we have tested and loved.
items.summary_zh: 从现在起到网络星期一，我们去年评测过的最佳浴巾（来自Parachute）将享受八折优惠。我们最喜爱的带滤芯的淋浴喷头也是如此。欢迎来到“物有所值”专栏，在这里，Filter编辑将重点介绍我们已经试用并喜爱的产品中真正划算的折扣。

items.title: Sleep paralysis: when you’re awake, but can’t move – or even breathe | Letters
items.title_zh: 睡眠瘫痪：当你醒来时，却无法动弹，甚至无法呼吸|读者来信
items.summary: Readers recount their terrifying experiences of sleep paralysis in response to an article by Amy Fleming I experienced sleep paralysis and hypnagogic hallucinations from childhood and into adulthood, with the episodes only waning in my 30s ( Touch of evil: the terrifying truth…
items.summary_zh: 读者们在回应艾米·弗莱明（Amy Fleming）的一篇文章时，讲述了他们经历的恐怖睡眠瘫痪体验。我从童年到成年一直经历睡眠瘫痪和入睡性幻觉，直到30多岁时这些发作才逐渐减少（《邪恶的触碰：令人恐惧的真相……》）。
